sloka: आगच्छ रक्षोधिप मा विषादमवस्थितो ऽहं प्रगृहीतचापः।अवेहि मां शक्रसपत्न रामं मया मुहूर्ताद्भविता विचेताः ।। ६.६७.१३२ ।।
transliteration: āgaccha rakṣodhipa mā viṣādamavasthito 'haṁ pragṛhītacāpaḥ।avehi māṁ śakrasapatna rāmaṁ mayā muhūrtādbhavitā vicetāḥ ।। 6.67.132 ।।

translations.english: Distressed by heavy weight unable to get up evil minded Rakshasa fallen on the ground will not destroy monkeys.
